adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `apps/web/pages/api/cron/bookingReminder.ts` only constructs a `CalendarEvent` for `sendOrganizerRequestReminderEmail(evt)` and does not create/update calendar events or “push” anything to calendars. Also, the persisted `booking.destinationCalendar` in this codebase still appears to be a single relation (e.g. `handleNewBooking.ts` only `connect`s `evt.destinationCalendar[0].id`), so the reminder job cannot “aggregate per-host calendars” from the booking record as claimed. The finding relies on an assumed requirement/task title and a behavior (pushing reminders to co-host calendars) that is not shown in this diff.
